title: Open locus where a global section freely generates
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module and $s\in\Gamma(X,M)$. The generating locus of $s$ is the open union of all $U\subseteq X$ on which $s|_U$ is a free generator: for every open $V\subseteq U$, the map $\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_X)\to\Gamma(V,M)$, $r\mapsto r s|_V$, is bijective. For invertible $M$ [def-sc-invertible-module], this is the nonvanishing open $X_s$, i.e. the locus where the image of $s$ in $M\otimes\kappa(x)$ is nonzero.
